examples.text: The experience affected me deeply.

Libertarian paternalism is the view that, because the way options are presented to citizens affects what they choose, society should present options in a way that “nudges” our intuitive selves to make choices that are more consistent with what our more deliberative selves would have chosen if they were in control.

A consideration of the rationale of our passions seems to me very necessary for all who would affect them upon solid and pure principles.

glosses: To tend to by affinity or disposition.

examples.text: The drops of every fluid affect a round figure.

glosses: To burden (property) with a fixed charge or payment, or other condition or restriction.

glosses: To feel affection for (someone); to like, be fond of.

examples.text:
There is a Lady in Verona heere
Whom I affect: but she is nice, and coy,
And naught esteemes my aged eloquence.

examples.text: Amongst humane conditions this one is very common, that we are rather pleased with strange things then with our owne; we love changes, affect alterations, and like innovations.
